title: imify config profiles result
description: Written to stdout by `imify config profiles --json`: every profile in the config file, `default` first, then the other profiles sorted by name.

name.description: The profile name. `default` is the profile the top-level keys form.

active.description: Whether `--profile`, `IMIFY_PROFILE` or the default selects this profile. No profile is active when the selected one does not exist.

api_url.description: The API URL the profile resolves to without `--api-url` and `IMIFY_API_URL`: its own `api_url`, else the top-level `api_url`, else the built-in default.
